jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer – Applied AI (Non-Clinical)
jobs.description:
**About Teleradiology Solutions / Daignostix**
Teleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.
  
  
Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).
  
  
**Role Summary**
Daignostix builds the AI behind TRS's 24x7 teleradiology operations and the products used by radiologists, hospital partners and internal teams. Beyond clinical imaging models, this includes algorithms that route and prioritise cases, predict TAT and forecast volumes and radiologist coverage, along with mobile applications that put these capabilities in users' hands.
  
  
As a Junior AI Engineer – Applied AI (Non-Clinical), you will build and ship operational ML algorithms and AI-enabled mobile features end to end under the guidance of senior engineers, using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to move quickly without compromising quality. This role does not work on clinical diagnostic models.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Operational algorithms. Build, train and evaluate models for case routing and worklist prioritisation, TAT prediction, radiologist scheduling and RVU/volume forecasting, and anomaly detection on operational data.
* Mobile AI features. Build AI-enabled features in mobile apps (React Native, Flutter or native iOS/Android) and integrate them with backend model services.
* On-device inference. Convert, optimize, and deploy machine learning models such as LightGBM, XGBoost, and scikit-learn models for production use, balancing accuracy, inference latency, memory usage, and model size.
* Data and evaluation. Build data pipelines from operational systems, define success metrics with operations stakeholders, and measure model impact against baselines in production.
* AI-assisted development. Use Claude Code and similar agentic coding tools in day-to-day development, while owning the review, testing and correctness of everything you ship.
* Production engineering. Package models as tested services (Python, Docker, FastAPI) with unit and regression tests, logging and monitoring. Senior engineers lead architecture and deployment.
* Stakeholder collaboration. Work with operations, product and engineering teams to turn workflow problems into measurable AI solutions.

**Requirements**
**Must-have:**

* Education. B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MS/M.Sc. from an IIT, IISc, IIIT, BITS Pilani or a comparably selective institution, in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record.
* Experience. 2-4 years of hands-on software and ML engineering, including mobile applications and ML models that reached real users.
* Proof of building. At least one mobile app or ML system that you personally built and shipped to real users, and can defend in technical depth.
* Programming. Strong Python skills with hands-on experience in machine learning frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, and LightGBM, along with proficiency in building and deploying production-grade ML solutions.
* AI-assisted development. Regular use of Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools on real projects, with sound judgement in reviewing and testing AI-generated code.
* ML fundamentals. Tabular, time-series and optimisation problems: feature engineering, gradient-boosted models, forecasting, classification metrics and experimental design.
* Engineering basics. Linux, Git, Docker, REST APIs, pytest and basic CI/CD.

**Good-to-have:**

* On-device ML. Experience deploying and optimizing machine learning models such as LightGBM, XGBoost, and scikit-learn models, including model compression, inference optimization, and efficient production deployment.
* Operations research. Scheduling, queueing or routing optimisation (e.g., OR-Tools).
* LLMs and cloud. LLM APIs, RAG or agent workflows, and one of AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Shipping experience. App store releases, mobile analytics and exposure to healthcare workflows.

**Key Skills**
Python | scikit-learn | XGBoost / LightGBM | Time-Series Forecasting | Optimisation / OR-Tools | React Native / Flutter | Swift / Kotlin | PyTorch | Core ML / TensorFlow Lite / ExecuTorch | Claude Code / AI-Assisted Development | FastAPI / REST APIs | Docker | Git | pytest | CI/CD | MLflow / Weights & Biases
  
  
**Why Join Daignostix**

* AI that runs the operation. Your algorithms directly shape how cases flow across a 24x7 global teleradiology service.
* Ship to real users. Build mobile and backend features used by radiologists, hospital partners and internal teams.
* Modern tooling with mentorship. Work with Claude Code and current AI tooling, with senior technical review and visibility from build to production.

ConvertCart helps 500+ eCommerce brands increase conversions through personalization, search, recommendation, and optimization products. Front-end work is a smaller part of the role: familiarity with React and TypeScript is enough to follow a feature through to the UI.

**What You'll Do**

  

* Design, build, and maintain RESTful APIs and services in Node.js and Express.js, with AI coding agents as your default way of working.
* Model, query, and optimize data in MySQL, with reliability and performance in mind.
* Turn vague problems into clear, well-scoped specs that a teammate or an AI agent can execute correctly.
* Review AI-generated and human code critically, and back every change with tests and evidence that it works.
* Debug and profile production issues to their root cause, from the API down to the query.
* Make occasional front-end changes in React and TypeScript when a feature needs them.
* Improve how the team works with AI: shared project instructions, review checklists, and automated checks.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**AI-first engineering**

  

* Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents on real production work, beyond autocomplete.
* Can read unfamiliar code quickly and explain why a generated solution is right orwrong.
* Clear written communication: specs, tickets, and review comments are the main input to the work.
* Sound judgment about what not to hand to AI, such as customer data, credentials, and security-sensitive paths.

**Back-end**

  

* Strong hands-on experience building APIs and services with Node.js and Express.js.
* Solid knowledge of MySQL: schema design, queries, indexing, and optimization.
* Understanding of REST API design, authentication, and integration patterns.
* Can reason about service performance, data consistency, and failure handling, and spot when generated code gets them wrong.

**General**

------------------

We are hiring a Software Engineer to join Corporater's Product Engineering team in India. Nexus is Corporater's new platform for managing leads, cases, partners and the sales pipeline, built in-house as a custom application on AWS. You will help us build it.

You will join a small team of developers and a QA engineer, led by a hands-on Tech Lead, and work closely with the Product Owner and colleagues in Norway. **What you will do**
--------------------

In this role, with support from the senior engineers, you will:

* Build and test features across Nexus in Java and Spring Boot, and in React and TypeScript, working from clear tasks that grow in size as you learn and keeping to the module boundaries the team has agreed.
* Work with the relational and graph data models: write queries, migrations and tests for PostgreSQL, and help keep the relationships between accounts, people and Cases correct and fast.
* Help build REST API endpoints, events and webhooks, including idempotency keys, retries and the audit log that every write needs.
* Help build integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint through Microsoft Graph, and with our HR, ERP, e-signature, marketing and support systems.

* Learn how we run the platform: AWS, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring with OpenTelemetry and alerting, and help with runbooks and documentation.
* Take part in code reviews, planning and design workshops with the people who use Nexus, and ask questions early.
* Use AI tools, including AI coding assistants, with good judgement, and help integrate the AI service into the features that use it.

---------------------------

* A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience, including work on a production application.
* Solid Java skills and experience with Spring Boot, or strong skills in a comparable object-oriented language and the willingness to move to Java quickly. Good knowledge of data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design.
* Working knowledge of TypeScript and React. You are comfortable working across the stack.
* Relational database (RDBMS) skills: you can design normalised tables, write SQL with joins, aggregates and indexes, read a query plan, and explain transactions and constraints. Experience with PostgreSQL is welcome, and MySQL or SQL Server experience counts too.

* Care for security and privacy: you know why access control, personal data under GDPR and audit logs matter.
* Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to work well with colleagues and users in another country and time zone.
* Curiosity about AI tools and a willingness to build with them, including using AI coding assistants with good judgement. You do not need to be an AI specialist.

**Nice to have**

* A side project or open-source contribution that uses a database in a real application, with a repository we can look at.
* Experience with Spring Boot, or with building a REST API in any framework.

The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage - often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter.

### Role Overview

Were hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. Youll own features end to end - from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built - with growing independence and support from senior engineers.

Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Youll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support.

### What youll own in your first year

* **Own:** Own features and services end to end with speed and quality - build, test, release, monitor, fix.
* **Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones.** Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself.
* **Design.** Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers.
* **Quality.** Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them.
* **Customers.** Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next.
* **Code reviews.** Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you.

### What you must bring

These are the bar. We cant teach them on the job.

* **Experience:** 1-4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone.
* **Youve shipped code that runs in production.** Features or services you built, released and supported - not only coursework or prototypes.
* **You are strong at problem solving.** You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution.
* **You work independently toward a clear goal.** Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments.

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.

### Technical background

Youve built production software with a modern stack, such as:

* **Cloud:** hands-on with AWS - youve deployed and debugged services running on it.
* **Languages:** strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* **Frameworks:** modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
* **Databases:** solid data modeling and query fundamentals - you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how youd fix it.
* **Fundamentals:** data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency.

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.

### What sets great candidates apart

* **Impact you can explain.** You can say what changed because of something you built - for users, performance or reliability.
* **One problem you went deep on.** A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why.
* **Ownership beyond the ticket.** Youve fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked.
* **Framework mindset:** You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable.
* **Learning speed.** Youve picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it.
* **Curiosity about the user.** Youve asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the users problem.

### What we look for in everyone we hire

Whatever the role, we hire for six things.

* **Customer obsession.** You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them.

As a Software Engineer, you will contribute to systems supporting licensing, entitlements, product activation, secure software downloads, ecommerce, tenant provisioning, customer and partner experiences, and integrations with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce and other Ivanti systems.

This role combines hands-on software development with opportunities to grow in solution design and production support. You will collaborate with experienced engineers to modernize applications, strengthen service and integration boundaries, and deliver secure, observable, and maintainable software.

* Designing, develop, test, deploy, and support enterprise applications and services used for licensing, entitlements, activations, secure downloads, ecommerce, customer access, and system integration.

* Integrating enterprise systems through stable APIs and asynchronous messaging, applying established patterns for validation, retries, idempotency, error handling, and failure recovery.
* Helping keep third-party platform details behind maintainable service interfaces and adapters so core business logic remains understandable and supportable.

* Use Git and Azure DevOps to manage source code, work items, automated builds, quality checks, deployment pipelines, and release traceability.

**Job Title: Computer Vision Engineer Terminal Guidance (EO/IR)**

**Location: Bengaluru / Bangalore (KIADB Aerospace Park, Devanahalli)**

**Experience: 1 – 2 Years**

**Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent**

**Industry: Aerospace & Defence / Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV)**

  

**About the Opportunity:**

  

We are hiring on behalf of our client, Green Aero Propulsion (Bengaluru), a pioneering aerospace and defence technology company. You will join the core perception team developing the EO/IR-based Terminal Guidance Pipeline for AgniPankh—an indigenous, transonic unmanned strike platform engineered to operate autonomously in GPS-denied environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Design, train, and optimize deep-learning models for real-time object detection, recognition, and multi-target tracking under strict Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) constraints.
* Develop robust computer vision algorithms capable of handling complex aerial/UAV challenges, including oblique viewing angles, rapid scale changes, motion blur, and low-contrast Infrared (IR) scenes.
* Implement multi-sensor fusion pipelines combining Electro-Optical (EO), Infrared (IR), and Inertial Navigation System (INS) data using Kalman / Extended Kalman Filters (EKF) and Particle Filters.
* Perform camera calibration, lens distortion correction, homography estimation, and multi-spectral (EO-to-IR) image registration.
* Integrate perception nodes into UAV/robotic software architectures using ROS / ROS 2 in a Linux/Docker environment.
* Support edge deployment and closed-loop simulation testing to validate targeting accuracy and low-latency inference.

  

**Mandatory Qualifications & Skills:**

  

* Education: B.Tech / M.Tech / Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline with a strong focus on Computer Vision.
* Experience: 1+ years of hands-on experience in object detection, recognition, and tracking using deep-learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent).
* Domain Experience: Demonstrated work on aerial/UAV imagery or thermal/IR datasets (handling scale variation, motion blur, and low contrast).
* Programming & DevOps: Strong coding proficiency in Python and C/C++; hands-on familiarity with Linux, Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Computer Vision Fundamentals: Solid understanding of camera models, lens distortion, homographies, and multi-spectral image registration.
* Sensor Fusion & Middleware: Familiarity with sensor-fusion concepts (EO + IR + INS), Kalman/EKF/Particle-filter tracking, and working knowledge of ROS / ROS 2.
* Eligibility: Must be an Indian Citizen capable of obtaining necessary security clearances for defence projects.

  
  

**Good-to-Have / Preferred Skills:**

  

* Prior experience in defence, missile guidance, or loitering-munition vision systems.
* Hands-on experience deploying models on embedded edge hardware (NVIDIA Jetson, Intel Movidius, Xilinx/AMD FPGA) using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, quantization (INT8/FP16), pruning, or knowledge distillation.
* Proficiency with simulation environments (AirSim, Gazebo, or FlightGear) for vision-in-the-loop testing.
* Familiarity with scene-matching algorithms (TERCOM, DSMAC), SAR/mmWave radar image processing, or GAN/diffusion-based synthetic data generation.
* Exposure to MIL-STD or DO-178C/DO-254 certification processes, or published research/patents in aerial object detection, visual SLAM, or safety-critical vision systems.
